vision.title: Vision, scope, product
vision.lead: Becoming a sheep agritech ecosystem that connects fodder, energy, individual identity and analysis — for fairer decisions, even beyond network coverage.

plateforme.title: What this platform is
plateforme.desc: An administration, liaison and decision-support layer.
plateforme.li1: Link the RFID identity to the animal record.
plateforme.li2: Capture the useful minimum, even offline.
plateforme.li3: Feed data to the Data-Driven Nutrition Engine.
plateforme.li4: Show a recommendation to the authorised user.
plateforme.li5: Synchronise without silent loss, with visible state.
plateforme.li6: Show the production indicators that can be computed.

pillars.title: Four pillars — frozen names
pillars.p2role: Turns validated data into a usable ration.
pillars.p4role: Links the animal to its identity, events and analysis.

decisions.title: Founding decisions
decisions.d01: OVITECH is an ecosystem, not just an app.
decisions.d02: Value is the decision, not the archive.
decisions.d03: The business project is the sheep / red-meat farm.
decisions.d04: The platform runs the project — it is not the project.
decisions.d05: The four pillars form a single value unit.
decisions.d06: RFID, cameras, scale: enabling techniques, not innovation in isolation.
decisions.d07: The MVP proves RFID + Offline First + engine + sync + KPI.
decisions.d08: Multi-tenant SaaS is an Enterprise stage, not the MVP.
decisions.d09: This console does not invent an official nutritional science.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.r1body: RFID scan, Offline First, engine, visible sync, baseline indicators.
roadmap.r2body: Sensors and flows validated one by one. Cameras and scales only if value is proven.
roadmap.r3body: Isolation, governance, operations. Not before the MVP exit door.

home.title: From individual data to production decisions.
home.lead: OVITECH is not a standalone app. It is the operational layer for sheep farming: RFID identity, offline capture, a nutrition engine, and indicators — one single loop.
home.proofBody: Cut the network, scan OV-2401, issue a ration, restore the link, then sync. For an engine refusal: OV-2410 (no weight).
home.reviewDesc: Rations awaiting a human glance — no physical execution.
home.pillarIdentBody: Every decision is tied to a specific animal, not a vague batch.
home.pillarEngineBody: Deterministic, traceable engine — no pretence of AI.
home.pillarFeedBody: Feed availability and cost to anchor the recommendation.
home.pillarEnergyBody: MVP limited representation: autonomy and daily load.
home.latestDesc: Engine output, not a physical execution order.
home.journalDesc: Each event carries a sync status.

scan.simuleSub: no physical RFID read — hardware planned for Growth phase (Q-07).
scan.toastBlocage: Engine: insufficient data — no ration invented
scan.inconnuDesc: No animal is linked to "{{query}}". No recommendation — identity precedes inference.

journee.lead: Daily queue: who to scan, who to weigh, who to distribute. The rounds continue offline — sync status stays visible.
journee.offline: Offline — entries remain local until connection is restored.
journee.rationsDesc: Production review done — the physical act remains human.

health.title: Health & vigilance
health.lead: Health is read on the animal: deterministic flags (weight, BCS, scan, gestation, engine output), care events, and a veterinary review recommendation. The console never issues a medical diagnosis.
health.vetReviewNote: A reading recommendation, not a diagnosis — the decision stays human.
health.organizerDesc: A direct reading of the animal registry — flags are computed, not typed by hand.
health.eventsDesc: Acts recorded on the file — each carries its sync state.
health.toastRequired: A note is required to save the event

ecosysteme.title: OVITECH ecosystem
ecosysteme.lead: One farm, four pillars, one loop: data flows from the field to the decision. This page shows the full system and the layer that produces most of the data — the connected field equipment.
ecosysteme.idea: Close the loop between the field and fattening: every animal carries an identity (RFID), every weighing crosses a connected scale, every pass goes through a gate, and cameras feed the registry. The console does not only read forms — it reads the herd.
ecosysteme.simulationDesc: Smart cameras, RFID gates, connected scale and IoT sensors are simulated for this demo. Wiring them up is part of the Growth phase.
ecosysteme.mapDesc: Four pillars fed by a single data source: the herd and its farm.
ecosysteme.balanceDesc: Weighing without typing, live weight entering the ration engine.
ecosysteme.camerasDesc: Reads the collective state of the lot, early warning.
ecosysteme.iotDesc: Measured environment: pen climate, sprouted barley, water, activity.
ecosysteme.portailsDesc: RFID at passage points, identity confirmed at every entry.

cameras.title: Smart cameras
cameras.lead: The camera reads the whole lot at a glance: cohesion, posture, behaviour. An early warning comes from a gap, not from typing.
cameras.roleDesc: Field layer — collective reading, no form.
cameras.role: The cameras feed the registry by reading the lot's collective state. They turn a behavioural drift (withdrawal, abnormal posture) into a signal to watch in herd health.

portails.title: Smart gates
portails.lead: Every pass confirms an identity. RFID at passage points turns the handling-lane entrance into a registry event.
portails.roleDesc: Field layer — identity confirmed at every entry.
portails.role: The RFID gates attach every pass to an animal file: the animal is identified before being weighed or directed. They are the entry point of the data chain.

balance.title: Connected scale
balance.lead: Weighing without typing: the live weight crosses the scale and enters the ration engine directly. It is the richest registry data.
balance.roleDesc: Field layer — weighing without manual entry.
balance.role: The connected scale captures live weight at every pass. This measurement feeds the ration engine (DDNE), ADG tracking and health flags. Without it, the engine refuses any invented ration.

iot.title: IoT / sensors
iot.lead: The environment measures the conditions: pen temperature and humidity, sprouted-barley unit, energy. The sensors add a reading of the surroundings to the individual reading.
iot.role: The IoT sensors track the farm conditions: pen climate (temperature, humidity), the sprouted-barley production unit, water and energy. They set the context for decisions — a ration reads with the environment the animal is raised in.
iot.climatDesc: One sensor per pen: temperature and humidity measured continuously. A climate gap is a signal before the action.
iot.hydroDesc: Green-fodder production in a controlled unit: temperature, humidity, harvest cycles and available biomass feed the forage chain.

troupeau.title: Herd
troupeau.lead: Individual identity first. Batch indicators do not replace the animal ↔ data ↔ decision link.

animal.gestRestant: {{remaining}} days estimated until due date ({{term}} d)
animal.gestTerme: Working due date {{term}} d — to be validated by the livestock expert.
animal.captureDesc: Weight and BCS — the minimum required for the engine. Works offline.
animal.transfertDesc: Movement is logged and remains local when offline.
animal.historiqueDesc: ADG calculated between the two latest valid weighings — not an invented target.
animal.deuxPesees: At least two weighings are required to calculate ADG.
animal.recsDesc: Each output cites its evidence. No autonomous physical execution.

nutrition.title: Nutrition engine
nutrition.lead: Converts individual data and forage context into a readable ration. Version {{version}}: deterministic rules with displayed evidence. This is not a learning model.
nutrition.modeleDesc: Documented formulas — to be validated by a nutrition expert.
nutrition.f2: Growth ME ≈ 23 MJ / kg of target ADG by stage
nutrition.f3: Lactation ME ≈ 5 MJ / kg milk (assumption 1.1 kg)
nutrition.f5: Required input: live weight. Without it, the engine refuses to issue.
nutrition.parcDesc: Each animal remains a distinct identity — the pen does not aggregate rations into an opaque average.

ration.title: Today's ration
ration.lead: Aggregation of the latest individual outputs by pen. Production review is not distribution: stock is debited only on the field action (A-09).
ration.bloqueDesc: Enter the missing weight or run the engine from the pen. The engine refuses to invent.
ration.footer: Costs from available Hybrid Feed lots. Business targets TBD (Q-09) — this sheet does not invent them.

fourrage.title: Feed units
fourrage.lead: What the farm holds in stock versus what the herd eats every day. In one glance: how many days of feed are covered, and where to act.
fourrage.heroSub: This stock covers the herd's needs for {{days}} days.
fourrage.heroHint: Available forage and hybrid lots, compared with the daily need from the latest rations.
fourrage.concSub: The concentrate stock covers {{days}} days of needs.
fourrage.concHint: Available concentrate (or hybrid), compared with today's need.
fourrage.distDesc: What the farm holds, lot by lot, relative to the day's need.
fourrage.indispoDesc: The engine will raise the concentrate share or refuse to issue if no lot is available — the real link between feed production and the nutrition engine.

energie.title: Smart Solar Park
energie.lead: The farm's solar park seen from the console: what the sun produces, what the farm consumes, and the level of electrical autonomy reached.
energie.heroSub: {{pct}} % of the farm's electricity needs are covered by the solar park.
energie.heroHint: Production / consumption ratio over recent days. Console read.
energie.chargesDesc: What the park's energy protects first on the farm.
energie.l4role: Conditional Q-08 — not a full plant
energie.demoBody: Demonstration park: the equipment is not yet measured on the ground (E-09). Figures come from the console and remain simulated — no real performance is displayed.

indicateurs.title: Production indicators
indicateurs.lead: Working dictionary pending the official one (Q-04). Each figure cites its source. Numeric targets remain TBD — this console does not invent business targets.
indicateurs.demoNote: Demo data — fictional pilot farm. No measured economic impact (Q-09): these figures are not Label proof.
indicateurs.chartGmqDesc: Farm-level series, not a numeric target.
indicateurs.chartIdentDesc: Share of events linked to a valid RFID.
indicateurs.dictLead: Provisional names, formulas, and sources. Official adoption awaits the Product Owner, production manager, and domain expert.

sync.title: Synchronisation

backup.importDesc: Restore from an OVITECH backup file (integrity + version check).
backup.confirmLead: Will replace {{current}} animals ({{pending}} pending) with {{incoming}} animals. Export first if needed.

journal.incidentsDesc: Failures, conflicts, disconnections — each keeps its local copy.
journal.noIncidents: No open incidents. Simulate a failure from
journal.refusDesc: A ration is never invented. These records await data entry.

preuve.title: MVP proof dossier
preuve.lead: The innovation is not RFID, nor a camera, nor a dashboard. It is the identity → data → recommendation → sync loop, including offline. This dossier reads the real state of the pilot farm.
preuve.equationDesc: Reliable identity + validated data + Offline First + nutrition analysis + recommendation + verifiable sync.
preuve.ch1: RFID scan linked to an animal
preuve.ch7h: A-09 · stock debited on action, not on review
preuve.ch9: Failure or conflict handled without silent loss
preuve.ch10: Forage context linked to the engine
preuve.exportDesc: Replayable state file — not a slide. Startup Label Algeria: conceptual alignment, not a guarantee of approval.
preuve.n1: Not a learning model. Version {{version}}: deterministic rules.
preuve.n2: Not a physical RFID reader — the scan is simulated pending Q-07.
preuve.n3: Not autonomous physical execution — the ration is a decision aid.
preuve.n4: Not a multi-tenant SaaS. That remains an Enterprise stage.
preuve.n5: Not a complete feed mill or energy digital twin.

verification.title: Engine verification
verification.lead: Deterministic test bench for version {{version}}. Each case re-reads the local herd — if you entered a weight on OV-2410, the expected refusal will fail, and that is intentional.
verification.signDesc: Records a livestock / nutrition opinion on the replayable protocol. It is not a national scientific accreditation (Q-02, Q-10).
verification.signHint: Reset the pilot farm to sign the intact reference set.
verification.toastConsigne: Protocol recorded — working opinion, not an official accreditation
verification.auDelaTitle: What these cases do not replace
verification.auDelaDesc: An expert must still adopt the official formulas. Here: technical replayability, not an official scientific opinion.
verification.b1: No machine learning, no training dataset.
verification.b2: Formulas are a v0.9 reference model, order-of-magnitude.
verification.b3: ADG targets by stage remain working assumptions.
